summary.name: Tiny Player for Mac
summary.one_liner: Tiny Player for Mac is a free, minimalist music player with a native macOS interface.
use_cases: playing local MP3 files on a Mac
minimal alternative to heavy music apps
playing FLAC or WAV files on macOS
organizing a small playlist with cover art
summary.what_it_does: Tiny Player for Mac plays local audio files including MP3, and also FLAC, AAC, AIFF and WAV. It has a native macOS interface and supports drag and drop for adding files. Features listed include a compact mode, a playlist, cover art display and quick search. The page says it runs on macOS 13 and later and supports both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
notable: Drag and drop support for files
